thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: preproc service p99 latency 3.8s (SLO 2s) on route /v1/generate-stream — observed spike at 2026-03-15T10:12:30Z. Affected customers: multiple streaming customers in us-west-2.

mika: oncall here, got the page. jumping in. any obvious errors in logging?

jordan: I can see a tail of requests stuck in tokenizer stage. p95 ~1.4s but p99 is huge. streaming stalls reported by client side. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/preproc?panelId=42

priya: hooking up to the preproc pod logs now. looks like a surge of large tool-schema payloads with nested templates, a lot of JSON-mode parsing.

dmitri: @priya can you paste the offending example?

priya: here’s a representative request (sanitized):
```json
{"inputs": "...", "tools": [{"schema": {"type":"object","properties":{/* huge schema */}}}], "prompt_template": "{{tools[0].instructions}} {{user}}"}
```

mika: that prompt_template change was rolled out in the template-service yesterday (template v3). Could be heavier validation.

jordan: stack traces show repeated calls into the schema validator in preproc tokenizer. CPU spikes on preproc pods to 95% and RT ~4s for some requests.

alerts-bot: New error rate: 0.8% 5m error window for preproc (baseline 0.02%).

mika: immediate mitigation options: 1) enable fast-path: bypass deep schema validation for streaming route; 2) scale preproc replicas; 3) revert template v3. What’s fastest?

sam: fastest is 1) toggle `TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=off` for the streaming worker pool. I can flip it now. scaling takes a few mins and might not help the tail.

priya: agree. disabling validation should kick in <30s. prepared toggle in console: /ops/configs/preproc/streaming

mika: do it. also add a temporary rule to reject >200KB tool schemas with a 413 to protect the tail.

sam: doing toggle now.

sam: (04:10) flipped TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VALIDATION=off for streaming pool. rolling restart of 3 worker pods initiated.

jordan: seeing immediate drop in CPU on restarted pods. p99 dropped from 3.8s -> 1.7s over next 90s. streaming stalls reduced.

priya: adding a WAF rule to cap tool schema payloads at 200KB. pushed rule to edge CDN (edge rule id: ER-8382).

mika: customer impact check: which customers saw degraded streaming? dashboard traces show 7 customers with >10% stream stalls, top three are: AcmeApp, DataWeave, GovPartner. Priya, can you confirm support tickets?

priya: AcmeApp has a severity-2 ticket opened at 10:15. DataWeave on hold, GovPartner flagged for SLA review. Notifying CSMs.

dmitri: we should also look at the tokenizer implementation — it's spending cycles serializing the tool schema into an AST for every request. Maybe we can cache parsed schemas by hash.

mika: agreed — follow-up engineering action: cache schema parse results, add size-based short-circuit, and add a perf test for template v3.

sam: does anyone object to reverting template-service v3 immediately if we still see instability after the bypass?

jordan: no objection. but bypass bought enough time to avoid revert for now. keep rollback path ready.

priya: note: we saw a handful of streaming completions that timed out client-side before mitigation. estimate 0.2% of overall streaming calls during window had visible stalls to customers.

mika: handoff plan: I'll stay on for 30m, run the preproc heap + cpu profiles, and then handoff to night oncall @sam at 11:00 PST with runbook attached.

mika: immediate post-incident tasks (short):
- create an alert for schema-payload-size > 150KB on streaming route
- implement schema-parse cache prototype (eng-runtime)
- add template v3 perf test to pre-merge CI
- document the emergency `TEMPLATE_SCHEMA_VALIDATION` toggle and its console path

priya: logging note: add a structured debug flag to log schema sizes only when >100KB to avoid noise.

alerts-bot: Incident status: mitigated — SLO at risk but immediate customer impact reduced.

mika: thanks team. Sam, handoff to you at 11:00 PST. leaving notes in the incident doc and tagging in #postmortems. :wave:

sam: got it, I'll take night oncall. adding incident -> postmortems backlog. will follow up on cache RFC tomorrow.

jordan: filing short incident timeline now. will include graphs and minimal reproducer.

priya: sending CSMs the customer-impact summary and mitigation note.

mika: closing thread for live mitigation. we'll reopen if regression occurs. :thumbsup:
